name: MediaMedic
description: MediaMedic is a Discord-driven media repair assistant for Radarr and Sonarr. Trusted users can report corrupt, incorrect, or otherwise bad movie and TV files from Discord. MediaMedic verifies the exact Radarr/Sonarr-managed file, can conservatively blocklist a proven bad release, removes the bad managed file, triggers a replacement search, and tracks download/import progress back to Discord. Configuration is handled through the built-in Web UI; no media filesystem mount is required.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent MediaMedic settings, SQLite repair history, and tracking state.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the MediaMedic Web UI.
